response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as overall_average FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation) SELECT sa.observstation, sa.station_avg, sa.station_avg - oa.overall_average as difference FROM station_avgs sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.station_avg > oa.overall_average ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
